items.title: Baker Mayfield: Extremely light workload in return
items.text:
Mayfield completed seven of 11 passes for 64 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions and rushed once for one yard in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Devin Singletary: Last back standing in Week 7
items.text:
Singletary carried the ball five times for 41 yards and a touchdown and caught all three of his targets for 14 yards in Sunday's 27-24 overtime win over the Texans.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: J.J. McCarthy: Little production in OT win
items.text:
McCarthy completed 20 of 28 passes for 252 yards and no touchdowns or interceptions in Sunday's 27-21 overtime win over the Texans. He added one yard on his only carry.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chase Brown: Garners 58 total yards in wiun
items.text:
Brown rushed 11 times for 39 yards and brought in four of five targets for 19 yards in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

items.title: Jaylen Waddle: Chest injury confirmed
items.text:
Waddle didn't return to Sunday's 30-16 win over the Cardinals due to a chest injury, Parker Gabriel of the Denver Post reports.
